SELECT 
    g.i_manager_id,
    g.sum_sales,
    (a.total_sum / a.count_d_moy) AS avg_monthly_sales
FROM (
    SELECT 
        i.i_manager_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales,
        d.d_moy
    FROM item i
    INNER JOIN store_sales ss
        ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1233
        AND (
            (i.i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics') 
                AND i.i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help') 
                AND i.i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9'))
            OR
            (i.i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men') 
                AND i.i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants') 
                AND i.i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1'))
        )
    GROUP BY i.i_manager_id, d.d_moy
) g
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        i_manager_id,
        SUM(sum_sales) AS total_sum,
        COUNT(d_moy) AS count_d_moy
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            i.i_manager_id,
            SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales,
            d.d_moy
        FROM item i
        INNER JOIN store_sales ss
            ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        INNER JOIN date_dim d
            ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN store s
            ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1233
            AND (
                (i.i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics') 
                    AND i.i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help') 
                    AND i.i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9'))
                OR
                (i.i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men') 
                    AND i.i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants') 
                    AND i.i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1'))
            )
        GROUP BY i.i_manager_id, d.d_moy
    ) sub
    GROUP BY i_manager_id
) a
    ON g.i_manager_id = a.i_manager_id
WHERE 
    ABS(g.sum_sales - (a.total_sum / a.count_d_moy)) / NULLIF(a.total_sum / a.count_d_moy, 0) > 0.1
ORDER BY g.i_manager_id, (a.total_sum / a.count_d_moy), g.sum_sales
LIMIT 100
